definitions.validRun: QUALIFIED or CENSORED. CENSORED means a recovery criterion was not met within the observation window; measurement is otherwise valid.
definitions.doneExactInterval: Correct transfers whose terminal commit falls inside [injectedAt, clearedAt].
definitions.doneWindowBased: Sum over 30 s windows that end inside the fault interval (the v1 paper measure).
definitions.peakBacklog1s: Maximum, at 1 s steps from injection to clearance + 120 s, of accepted transfers not yet terminal.
definitions.faultEraClearedSeconds: Seconds after clearance until every transfer received before clearance was terminal.
definitions.latencyRestoredSeconds: First 1 s step after clearance where p95 latency of transfers arriving in the next 10 s is within 10% of the p95 of arrivals in the 60 s before injection (at least 10 arrivals).
definitions.rateRestoredSeconds: First 1 s step after clearance where completions in the next 10 s reach 90% of the pre-fault 60 s completion rate.
definitions.clientOutageSeconds: Span from the first failed client request sent to the last failed request answered.
definitions.pairs: REST and Kafka runs with the same repetition number; paired bootstrap of relative effect (Kafka-REST)/REST and exact sign randomization (src/experiment/analysis.js).
definitions.holm: Holm adjustment across the five primary contrasts.
